title: Choose AnimaSeek's symbol
question: Each direction is independent from the bird and keeps color. Choose the identity AnimaSeek should own, re-roll, or steer another pass.

options.label: Shared Aperture
options.lineage: color-separation contact prints and split-lens apertures
options.thesis: Two separate viewpoints overlap to create a third opening into something new.
options.viewport: A square app icon where two asymmetric color forms meet around one unmistakable central aperture.
options.risk: If the overlap becomes too symmetrical, it could resemble a generic link or infinity mark.

options.label: Uncensored Encounter
options.lineage: Polish film-poster surrealism translated into a compact mark
options.thesis: Two human presences become one impossible doorway, making discovery feel intimate and untamed.
options.case: Strongest cultural and emotional identification; less immediate product clarity at tiny icon sizes.
options.viewport: A square icon dominated by one surreal fused contour with a bright opening at its center.
options.risk: Its expressive texture may collapse when reduced to Spotlight and Settings sizes.

options.label: Signal Bloom
options.lineage: particle-detector event displays softened into an encounter symbol
options.thesis: Two signals meet and bloom into many paths: discovery made visible at the moment of connection.
options.case: Clearest connection-to-discovery mechanism; less human and more technical than the brief asks for.
options.viewport: A circular burst of a few disciplined tracks inside a dark square icon, with two paths entering and several leaving.
options.risk: It can be mistaken for a science, AI, or crypto product unless aggressively simplified.

options.label: Shared Horizon
options.lineage: folded night maps, textile seams, and shared dream edges
options.thesis: Separate places fold together so each reveals a new world inside the other.
options.case: Warmest expression of shared experience; the connection mechanism is more poetic than immediate.
options.viewport: A square icon where two folded horizons meet and reveal a small radiant world between them.
options.risk: It may read as a sleep, travel, or weather app before it reads as human discovery.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A central spark connects to a small constellation of people and paths.
canonCard.viewport: A balanced node-and-path emblem centered inside a conventional rounded app-icon field.
canonCard.risk: Immediately understandable, but interchangeable with many connection and discovery products.
